answer: No, you don't need to pay off your loan or have the title in hand to sell us your car. While the loan is open, your lender (the lienholder) holds the title or the electronic title record, so you don't need a duplicate either. At the appointment we confirm what you owe and pay your lender directly from your offer, and if the offer is more than the payoff, you get the difference. To speed things up, get a payoff letter from your lender before you come in.
